sections: morphology
One male and four female types
一雄四雌模式

The male holotype IB A.6440 measured 35.31 mm; four female paratypes measured 34.41–37.92 mm. The male was collected on 17 May 2023 at 58 m and females on 14 April 2022 at 146 m. A female smaller than the male prevents interpreting this series as a universal female-larger rule. These are five types, separate from the four newly sequenced samples.
雄正模 IB A.6440 长 35.31 毫米，四雌副模长 34.41–37.92 毫米。雄于 2023 年 5 月 17 日在 58 米采集，雌于 2022 年 4 月 14 日在 146 米采集。一雌小于雄，不能将该系列解读为普遍雌性更大的规则。五件模式与四个新测序样本分别计数。
morphology
Diagnosis and preservation retain different observations
诊断与保存材料保留不同观察

The diagnosis combines a distinct tympanum, relatively smooth dorsal skin with small low tubercles, grey belly with white dust, absent femoral and ventrolateral glands, absent toe webbing and a copper-gold iris. The male has a throat vocal sac; females do not. Preserved dorsal texture ranges from finely tuberculate to smooth, and colour differs from the living dark brown to nearly black holotype. These traits are sample-bound and do not substitute for a full identification key.
诊断组合包括明显鼓膜、较光滑背皮及小低瘤、带白粉点灰腹、股腺与腹侧腺缺失、趾无蹼及铜金虹膜。雄有喉声囊，雌没有。保存材料背皮从细瘤到光滑，颜色也与活体深褐至近黑正模不同。这些性状受样本限制，不能替代完整鉴定检索表。
ecology
Coastal stream records and ambient measurements
沿海溪流记录与环境测量

Types were observed on rocks or ground in a rocky stream in secondary evergreen coastal forest at 50–150 m. Reported site air temperature was 26.8–33.5 degrees Celsius and relative humidity 60–78%. These are ambient observations, not physiological tolerances or climate requirements. Sympatry with five other frogs is not evidence of diet or competition.
模式观察于海拔 50–150 米次生常绿沿海林的石质溪流，位于岩石或地面。地点气温报告 26.8–33.5 摄氏度、相对湿度 60–78%。这是环境观察，不是生理耐受界限或气候需求。与五种其他蛙同域不是食性或竞争证据。
evolution
A 16S reference dataset supports a limited placement
16S 参考数据支持有限系统位置

The analysis included 112 reference and new 16S sequences over 534 positions, with four newly collected samples. It placed the new lineage within the applebyi group with reported Bayesian/ML support 1.00/98 and a minimum compared 16S distance of 6.34% to macrops. This is not 112 new deocaensis specimens, nuclear evidence, a divergence date or a universal species threshold.
分析纳入 112 条新旧 16S 序列、534 位点，其中四个新采样本。新支系置于 applebyi 组，所报贝叶斯／最大似然支持为 1.00/98，与 macrops 的最小比较 16S 距离 6.34%。这不是 112 个新 deocaensis 标本、核基因证据、分化日期或通用物种阈值。
distribution
Known sites and survey nondetections
已知地点与调查未检出

The 2026 account knew the species only from Mui Dien coastal forest of Deo Ca Mountain. Surveys on adjacent hillsides found no animals, but the authors also describe the region as poorly studied. Apparent endemism and an association between divergence and environment remain interpretations. Nondetection does not prove absence or supply a current official conservation category; the authors call for threat assessment.
2026 年记述仅从 Deo Ca 山 Mui Dien 沿海林了解本种。相邻山坡调查未发现动物，但作者也说区域研究不足。似乎特有及差异与环境的关联仍属解释。未检出不能证明缺失或提供当前官方保护等级；作者呼吁评估威胁。
